lines.text: Abimelech and Phicol ask Abraham to swear not to deal falsely with them, and Abraham says he swears it.
Abraham complains about a well that Abimelech's servants seized, and Abimelech says he heard of it only that day.
Abraham gives Abimelech sheep and cattle, and the two men make a covenant.
Abraham sets apart seven ewe lambs as his witness that he dug the well, so the place is called Bethel.
Abimelech and Phicol return to the land of Canaan, and Abraham plants a tamarisk tree in Beersheba.
